  • First firing Aug 1, 2026

    What the kiln taught us the first time we loaded it. We stacked the shelves too tight, trusted a cone we had never tested and opened the door a day early; every pot that came out whole was luck, and every cracked one taught us something we still do today. Since then we fire slowly, keep a notebook by the door and test every new glaze on a tile first, because the kiln is patient with people who are patient with it.
